notes: Focused Stan-authoring probe (R/rstan surface): write a hierarchical Bayesian beta-binomial program (per-group binomial likelihood k ~ binomial(n, theta), shared beta group prior theta ~ beta(alpha,beta), and the exact Jeffreys-type hyper-prior target += -0.5*log(alpha)-0.5*log(beta)-0.5*log(alpha+beta)), plus a reusable deterministic R driver that validates the trial table, embeds the exact program, samples with a fixed seed and publishes posterior draws and a summary. The verifier re-runs the driver on visible and hidden tables (different group counts/sizes/rates), byte-checks the emitted program against the deliverable, independently compiles the deliverable Stan source and samples it against empirical germination rates (semantic proof that likelihood and prior structure are right), and checks invalid-input rejection. Hard: Stan syntax/semantics must survive an actual toolchain compile (failure mode: syntax or semantic error fails the model parse), plus quantitative posterior-vs-rate tolerances and multi-dataset generalization.
